feature: declared activity labels in before-and-after performance comparisons

behavior.sameLabel: shown as declared in both sessions, with a reminder that labels do not prove equivalent conditions
behavior.differentLabels: shown side by side with a prompt to review whether periods are comparable
behavior.missingLabels: shown as unavailable without inferring the measured task

localVerification.portableExeSmoke: main window opened, remained responsive, and closed cleanly

scope: No Windows configuration or optimization was applied. Session labels are supplied by the user and are not evidence that workloads or conditions were identical.
ciLimitations: CI acceptance ran on a Windows virtual machine, not every physical configuration.
The workflow does not perform real Windows repairs, restore-point creation, driver installation, offline scan, or reboot.
